data.content:
Nothing new broke against Spain. There are no fresh injuries from Saturday and nobody is suspended, which for this squad counts as good news after a week in which Cole Palmer, Declan Rice, Kobbie Mainoo, Marcus Rashford and Tino Livramento all withdrew on the same afternoon. [...] Czechia are likely to defend in the same 4-2-3-1 they used against Croatia, with the two holding midfielders protecting the space in front of the center-backs and the attacking players looking to break quickly once possession changes hands. [...] Saka against a low block usually means repeated isolation against the left back. Slama got through 90 minutes against Croatia without being exposed because Croatia had the ball. He'll have a different evening.

### Harry Kane vs Robin Hranac and Stepan Chaloupek

Kane scored at Wembley and then missed the penalty that would have made it 3-1. Against two centre-backs who will defend deep, his value shifts to dropping off and turning, which is where he has always hurt organised defences.
